legend: Last week, you were contacted by aliens. Strangely, no one you tell seems to believe you – this is likely some form of alien brainwashing. Nonetheless, you decided to reply to the message, and with the help of a few video tutorials, a rocket with a picture of you and your cat is currently long underway to the aliens. Perhaps more importantly, the rocket also contains an array of n$$$n$$$ bits, all set to 0$$$0$$$. This was specifically requested by the aliens: "State your intentions. Send an array of bits set to 1$$$1$$$ to indicate you wish to remain peaceful. In any other case, we will destroy your planet." Wait, what? Set to 1$$$1$$$? Whoops.

Luckily, the rocket is equipped with a Bit Array Protection Controller (BAPC). The BAPC can be opened up to expose a contiguous section of the bit array to interstellar radiation, independently setting each of the exposed bits to either 0$$$0$$$ or 1$$$1$$$, each with a probability of 50%$$$50\%$$$. Your idea is to exploit this randomness to set most of the bits in the array to 1$$$1$$$. The aliens sounded serious, but not that serious, so setting at least 70%$$$70\%$$$ of the bits to 1$$$1$$$ is probably fine. Unfortunately, the rocket has almost reached its destination, so you can open up the BAPC at most 125$$$125$$$ times before the aliens read the array. Send the correct commands to the BAPC to ensure at least 70%$$$70\%$$$ of the bits are set to 1$$$1$$$.

This is an interactive problem. Your submission will be run against an interactor, which reads from the standard output of your submission and writes to the standard input of your submission. This interaction needs to follow a specific protocol:
The interactor first sends one line with an integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤1000$$$1\leq n\leq 1000$$$), the length of the bit array v$$$v$$$.

Then, your program should send at most 125$$$125$$$ commands to set at least 70$$$70$$$% of the bits to 1$$$1$$$. Each command is sent by printing one line of the form "ℓ$$$\ell$$$ r$$$r$$$" (1≤ℓ≤r≤n$$$1\leq \ell \leq r\leq n$$$), which will expose the bits in positions [ℓ,r]$$$[\ell, r]$$$ to interstellar radiation. The interactor will respond with two lines. The first line consists of n$$$n$$$ integers v1,v2,…,vn$$$v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_n$$$ (vi∈{0,1}$$$v_i \in \{0,1\}$$$ for each i$$$i$$$), the new state of the array. The second line contains a single integer p$$$p$$$ (0≤p≤100$$$0 \leq p \leq 100$$$), the current percentage of ones, rounded down.
When the percentage of ones is at least 70$$$70$$$, the interaction will stop. Sending any additional commands after this point or using more than 125$$$125$$$ commands will result in a wrong answer.
For each of your submissions, the interactor uses a new random seed. The interactor is not adaptive. Your submission will be run on at most 100$$$100$$$ test cases.
Make sure you flush the buffer after each write.
A testing tool is provided to help you develop your solution.

legend.ai: 上周，你联系到了外星人。奇怪的是，你告诉的每个人似乎都不相信你——这很可能是某种形式的外星人洗脑。尽管如此，你还是决定回复这条消息，在几个视频教程的帮助下，一枚带有你和你的猫的照片的火箭目前正飞往外星人那里。也许更重要的是，火箭中还装有一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的位数组，其所有位都被设置为 0$$$0$$$。这是外星人特别要求的：“陈述你的意图。发送一个所有位都设置为 1$$$1$$$ 的位数组，以表明你希望保持和平。在任何其他情况下，我们将摧毁你的星球。”等等，什么？设置为 1$$$1$$$？糟糕。

幸运的是，火箭配备了位数组保护控制器(Bit Array Protection Controller，BAPC)。BAPC 可以打开，使位数组的一段连续区间暴露在星际辐射下，并以 50%$$$50\%$$$ 的概率独立地将暴露出的每一位设置为 0$$$0$$$ 或 1$$$1$$$。你的想法是利用这种随机性，将数组中的大多数位设置为 1$$$1$$$。外星人听起来很认真，但还没认真到那种程度，所以将至少 70%$$$70\%$$$ 的位设置为 1$$$1$$$ 可能就足够了。不幸的是，火箭几乎已经抵达目的地，因此在外星人读取数组之前，你最多只能打开 BAPC 125$$$125$$$ 次。向 BAPC 发送正确的指令，确保至少 70%$$$70\%$$$ 的位被设置为 1$$$1$$$。
这是一个交互题。你的程序会与交互器一同运行，交互器从你的程序的标准输出中读取内容，并将内容写入你的程序的标准输入。交互必须遵循特定协议：
交互器首先发送一行，其中包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤1000$$$1\leq n\leq 1000$$$)，表示位数组 v$$$v$$$ 的长度。

然后，你的程序应发送至多 125$$$125$$$ 条指令，使至少 70$$$70$$$% 的位变为 1$$$1$$$。每条指令都通过输出一行形如“ℓ$$$\ell$$$ r$$$r$$$”(1≤ℓ≤r≤n$$$1\leq \ell \leq r\leq n$$$)的内容发送，这将使位置 [ℓ,r]$$$[\ell, r]$$$ 上的位暴露在星际辐射下。交互器将回复两行。第一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 v1,v2,…,vn$$$v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_n$$$(对于每个 i$$$i$$$，vi∈{0,1}$$$v_i \in \{0,1\}$$$)，表示数组的新状态。第二行包含一个整数 p$$$p$$$(0≤p≤100$$$0 \leq p \leq 100$$$)，表示当前 1 的百分比，向下取整。
当 1 的百分比至少为 70$$$70$$$ 时，交互将停止。在此之后发送任何额外指令，或发送超过 125$$$125$$$ 条指令，都会导致答案错误。
对于你的每次提交，交互器都会使用新的随机种子。交互器不是自适应的。你的提交最多会在 100$$$100$$$ 个测试用例上运行。
确保每次写入后都刷新缓冲区。
提供了一个测试工具来帮助你开发解决方案。
